edges.reason: owner is assigned tx.origin in the Plethori constructor, making ownership dependent on the transaction origin.
Constructor writes allowance[tx.origin][uniPair] = uint(-1), granting unlimited approval to the origin address.
tx.origin is read during Plethori constructor execution to establish privileges.
block.timestamp + 600 is used as the Uniswap liquidity deadline, a miner-manipulable dependency.
Plethori.transfer uses msg.sender as the source of the token transfer.
msg.sender is compared with _from and used to consume allowance in transferFrom.
approve writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender].
delegate is gated only by require(msg.sender == owner).
list is gated only by require(msg.sender == owner).
protectionFromBots supplies the target address of the low-level call in checkBots.
The external bot-protection call in the modifier executes before transferFrom mutates state, allowing reentrancy.

normalization_plan.reason: _from is a plain parameter of Plethori.transferFrom and drives the balance and allowance reads.
_to is a plain parameter of Plethori.transferFrom and is only used as the balance recipient.
_value is a scalar parameter of Plethori.transferFrom consumed by the unchecked arithmetic.
a is the parameter that directly supplies the delegatecall target.
b is the parameter that directly supplies the delegatecall calldata.
_numList is a scalar parameter only used to set balanceOf and the liquidity amounts.
_tos is an array parameter iterated by the distribution loop.
_amounts is an array parameter providing the assigned balances.
_spender is a plain parameter used as the allowance key.
_value is a plain parameter stored into the allowance mapping.
_botProtection is a plain parameter stored into protectionFromBots.
_from is only forwarded into the bot-protection call encoding.
_to is only forwarded into the bot-protection call encoding.
_value is only forwarded into the bot-protection call encoding.
_botProtection is a plain parameter forwarded to the BotProtected base constructor.
i is a local loop index that only controls iteration inside list.
sender is a plain parameter forwarded to _transfer and _approve.
recipient is a plain parameter forwarded to _transfer.
amount is a plain parameter used in the guarded allowance subtraction.
